description: This PHP script handles the saving, updating, and sending of email records within the SuiteCRM system. It manages email properties, attachments, templates, relationship linking, and page redirection after processing.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A class used for parsing email templates with object data.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Parses email templates replacing placeholders with actual data.

methods.name: handleAttachments
methods.description: Handles file attachments for the email being processed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or sends the email record to the database.
